findings.note: Rotowire (Oct 31): Reid went 0-for-6 from three in 36 minutes against the 76ers after a poor shooting night against the Wizards, and was benched for the second half against the Pistons. It also says his output may drop once Coby White (calf) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring) return.

Game log shows Reid made 4, 3, 5 and 2 threes (on 8+ attempts each) in his first four games, then 1 (13-minute benching game) and 0. He is the starting big with heavy shot volume while White and Knueppel are out, and his status for this game was not found.
In the Oct 21 game against this same Nets team, Reid went 4-for-10 from three with 20 points in 33 minutes, clearing 1.5 made threes easily.
